materialization: committed fixture tree + digest manifest (no git object required)
mechanism: S10 copies the committed pinned-source fixture into disposable scratch directories, verifies each file digest against pinned-source-manifest.json, mutates exactly one managed path, and runs compareBoilerplateDriftByMode/getDriftExitCode. When the pinned commit object exists locally, an optional provenance check compares fixture digests to git show output.
